name: Summarize Failed Lookups
plugin_description: Consolidates failure summaries from drug, pharmacy, and provider reference records linked to a phone call into a structured output, then archives the reference records.
action_description: Fetches all drug, pharmacy, and provider reference records for a phone call, summarizes match failures and needs-review items, patches the phone call record with the summary, and soft-deletes the reference records.

inputs.name: call_summary_name
inputs.label: Call Summary Name
inputs.description: Name of the phone call summary record to summarize

outputs.name: extraction_summary
outputs.label: Extraction Summary
outputs.description: JSON-encoded structured summary with counts and failure details per category (drugs, pharmacies, providers)

outputs.name: medication_user_summary
outputs.label: Medication User Summary
outputs.description: Human-readable summary of medication lookup failures and review items

outputs.name: pharmacy_user_summary
outputs.label: Pharmacy User Summary
outputs.description: Human-readable summary of pharmacy lookup failures and review items

outputs.name: provider_user_summary
outputs.label: Provider User Summary
outputs.description: Human-readable summary of provider lookup failures and review items
